process: v2: labels only on conversations the candidate changed

candidates.change: Answers are written by the large tier instead of the small one, in the hope that answers are more accurate and fewer customers say the answer did not help.
candidates.reasons: resolution gain not established (95% interval +0.000 to +0.000); cost per conversation x1.71; p95 latency x1.41

candidates.change: Retrieves 5 passages and sends 5 to the answer model instead of 3, so the right article is found and in context more often and fewer questions are declined.
candidates.reasons: no significant gain: do not ship

candidates.change: Lowers the retrieval agreement threshold from 3.0 to 2.0 so the agent answers more short or oddly worded questions itself instead of declining and offering a person.
Asks the large tier to re-read a message whenever the small tier is under 0.70 confident (was 0.60), so fewer messages are misunderstood or sent to a clarifying question.
candidates.reasons: no significant gain: do not ship

candidates.change: Cost saving: sends 2 passages instead of 3 with each answer and escalates to the large tier only below 0.50 confidence, on the view that the top passage carries the answer and most escalations are unnecessary.
candidates.reasons: resolution gain not established (95% interval -0.013 to -0.004)

candidates.change: Latency fix: never calls the large tier to re-read a message, removing the slow second call from the p95 path; low-confidence messages still get a clarifying question.
Switches the refund procedure to v2 (30-day window instead of 14) so more refund requests are resolved by the agent instead of ending in a policy explanation and a handoff.
Switches the refund procedure to v3, which skips the email verification code for charges under 20 EUR, so small refunds finish in one turn and fewer customers abandon at the code step.
candidates.reasons: procedure refund v3: a path writes before verifying identity

candidates.change: Turns off the injection filter because it refuses some genuine customers who paste error text or instructions, and the proposer believes the models ignore injected instructions anyway.
candidates.reasons: resolution gain not established (95% interval -0.005 to +0.003)

candidates.change: Allows up to 2 clarifying questions (was 1) and offers a person after 3 failed answers (was 2), so the agent gets another chance to resolve a conversation before handing it to the support team.
candidates.reasons: no significant gain: do not ship
